pages.text: Combine one iron ingot and one slimeball without a fixed shape.

Right-click within normal interaction reach to manage names, stats, orders, gear, and cargo. Stay within eight blocks and keep the tuner in either hand while using management. Shift-right-click recovers the companion, including when holding a tuner or scanner.
The Creative Slime Tuner edits base stats and current resources in Creative only. It has no Survival recipe. Shrinking Capacity requires emptying the slots that would be lost.
Place a Slime Tuner in the center of a crafting table, with glass directly above, below, left, and right.

Right-click your companion with a Slime Scanner to preview its current or planned work area for 15 seconds. Hold the scanner in either hand to keep it visible. Cyan marks range; gold marks the next section or registered plots. Scanning does not start work. Shift-right-click recovers the companion.
